items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Ferdinand Morton, I think was one, and I forget what the other fellow's name was now.

ctx.x:
See, so -- but so, and he controlled both parties. Ferdinand Morton, I think was one, and I forget what the other fellow's name was now.
Anyhow -- and when Connie Carney's Inn opened up, it was called Shuffle Inn. Well, in order to protect another cabaret called Happy Rhone's, Old Man Baron wouldn't let him have a darned dancing license. And wouldn't let Connie Carney have the Shuffle Inn, as it was called then. Wouldn't let him have a dancing license, and he didn't, he wouldn't give -- where the Cotton Club was,…
